text:
Maya (CSM): FYI spotted a cohort of 10 mid-market accounts with stalled onboarding flows and steady drop in daily active users. want to spin a rapid save play — focus on adoption, not just discounts.
Jorge (Support): what signals are we using to pick these? errors vs engagement vs setup incomplete?
Maya (CSM): primary: <50% of onboarding milestones completed + DAU drop >15% over 10d. secondary: NPS comment mentioning complexity.
Kellen (SuccessOps): I can produce the list. SQL I run:```sql
SELECT account_id, org_name, onboard_progress_pct, dau_change_10d, last_support_ticket
FROM onboarding_metrics
WHERE onboard_progress_pct < 50 AND dau_change_10d <= -15
ORDER BY dau_change_10d ASC
LIMIT 50;
```
Noor (Enablement): nice. my proposal: "concierge workshop" + a one-click checklist and 2-hour office hours for customers that hit milestone blockers. cohorts of 8, run twice a week.
Priya (AM): for accounts with renewal < 75d I want a pre-call that covers usage-based concession (not blanket discount). offer: reallocate unused seat credits + one-month free premium feature.
Jorge (Support): I'll flag any account with >2 setup tickets or recurring API errors and pair with an engineer. can we surface those in the export?
Kellen (SuccessOps): adding fields: last_ticket_count, top_error_tag, last_feedback_snippet. output to /cs/exports/onboard-drift-1722228000.csv in 5m.
Maya (CSM): core save-play steps: 1) outreach template & calendar link (Noor) 2) concierge workshop scheduled within 5 business days (Noor) 3) tactical troubleshooting/engineer pairing (Jorge) 4) tailored concession proposal (Priya) 5) feedback capture + playbook updates (Kellen).
Priya (AM): downgrade-path if customer insists on cutting spend: create a "lite" plan mapping that drops noncritical premium features and preserves data retention. include a re-upgrade coupon valid 45 days.
Noor (Enablement): outreach snippet (short):

"Hi <Name>, noticed setup stopped at step 3. would 45 minutes of live walk-through and a short checklist help? we can run it at no charge this week. interested?"

Maya (CSM): include a link to a 1-click checklist we can walk through; that'll reduce friction. Noor, can you build the checklist and the workshop slide deck?
Noor (Enablement): yes. checklist + deck in shared drive. will also add a quick adoption KPI card customers can screenshot.
Priya (AM): concession logic: prefer usage credits or feature month vs. straight % off. keeps ARR intact and encourages usage.
Jorge (Support): engineer pairing protocol: if top_error_tag == "auth_timeout" or ticket_count > 2 -> escalate to eng-pairing within 24h. otherwise standard runbook.
Kellen (SuccessOps): sample downgrade mapping (ops-friendly YAML):
```yaml
current_plan: GrowthPlus
upgrade_hold: false
lite_plan:
  keeps: [core-embed, basic-analytics]
  removes: [advanced-rerank, dedicated-throughput]
  min_seats: 5
  preserved_data_retention_days: 30
  reupgrade_coupon_days: 45
```
Maya (CSM): nice. Kellen can you also tag accounts with "concierge_eligible" and create tasks in CRM assigning owners?
Kellen (SuccessOps): will create CRM tasks with payload like:```json
{
  "account":"<id>",
  "task":"concierge_workshop_outreach",
  "owner":"Noor (Enablement)",
  "due":"2024-06-05"
}
```
OpsBot: automated note: 10 accounts flagged, avg onboard_progress 38%, avg dau_change_10d -22%. export ready at /cs/exports/onboard-drift-1722228000.csv
Priya (AM): timeline & owners: outreach by EOD, workshops scheduled in 5 business days, engineering pairing within 24h of ticket confirmation, concession proposals within 48h of workshop.
Jorge (Support): :white_check_mark: starting triage queue and tagging engineer pairs.
Noor (Enablement): :white_check_mark: building checklist + deck; will post link when ready.
Kellen (SuccessOps): :white_check_mark: export posted and CRM tasks created.
Priya (AM): :white_check_mark: concession template ready; will finalize per-account offers after workshop.
Maya (CSM): thanks all. when you hand off customer quotes, put them in the "adoption-feedback" column so product can prioritize simple wins. follow-up standup 2 days after first wave. tag me with blockers. :raised_hands:
